question: A hemispherical bowl has 3.5 cm radius. It is to be painted inside as well as outside. Find the cost of painting it at the rate of ₹15 per 10 cm². (Use π = 22/7.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total area to paint inside and outside (assuming negligible thickness) = 2 × CSA = 4πr²

Area = 4 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5 = 154 cm²

Cost of painting = Area × (Rate / 10)

Cost = 154 × (15 / 10) = 154 × 1.5 = ₹231

**∴ The correct answer is ₹231.**
